title: fix(enroll): forward the clone answer on stdout under --await, not only its exit code
description:
## what

`rhx enroll <brain> -p '<prompt>'` (default `--await`) forwards the clone's exit code but not its answer, so a caller that reads stdout sees no reply.

## why

`--await` is documented as "hold until the clone answers its prompt and exits, then forward its exit code". every route guard lane that enrolls a reviewer reads stdout for the verdict. with the answer absent, the guard sees only the enroll banner and permission notices.

## evidence

`ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-ehmpathy`, route `v2026_09_26.fix-blocklist-nudge`, stone 5.1 (peer rounds i004, i005):

- twice, the guard graded an enroll lane `💥 malfunction: reviewer output lacks a numeric blocker/nitpick count`
- yet `rhx clone get @:e691813d --format raw` showed the clone had finished a full review that ended `2 blockers, 4 nitpicks.`
- a second clone spawned in the same cwd in the same instant (i004) made it worse: `clone get` reported "history is empty because this clone shared a cwd with another at spawn", and that clone stayed LIVE over an hour

## shape

forward the clone's final reply on stdout under `--await` (the tree output's last block, or the raw reply under `--output json`).

clamp: enroll with `-p 'reply exactly: 0 blockers / 0 nitpicks'` and assert stdout holds both lines.

the consumer works around it today: each enroll lane has its clone write the final list to `.temp/route.review/<slug>.md` and print that file.
